proof_scope: live entrypoint behavior: full sanity e2e (memory recall, scene elements, persona records), per-feature pipeline runs (frames, SRT transcript, emotion analysis, reports), and fail-closed source resolution

claims.proves: sanity.sh e2e passes live; the pipeline extracts frames, parses English SRT transcript, detects SRT emotion cues, and writes report.json/md/html on a real video; run.sh fails closed on bad sources
claims.does_not_prove: movie acquisition via ingest-movie/Radarr, diarization runtime, YOLO identity ledger behavior (covered by the npm immutable-goal gate), or long-video rolling-window quality

capability_claims.description: End-to-end sanity: CLI loads, memory recall over watch_content answers questions, scene element and persona records are recallable
Unresolvable or non-media sources exit non-zero with an explanatory error instead of silently succeeding
Uniform/scene-change frame extraction produces a frames manifest with real frame files
English SRT is parsed into transcript.json segments
SRT emotion/cue analysis finds tagged scenes (shout/rage cues)
Every run writes report.json, report.md, and report.html with scene rows

cases.name: sanity-e2e-live
command: mkdir -p out && OUT=$PWD/out && cd .. && ./sanity.sh && curl -sf -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8601/recall -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"q":"watch scene elements","collections":["watch_content"],"k":1}' > "$OUT/recall_readback.json"

cases.name: pipeline-per-feature-real-video
command:
OUT=$PWD/out/feat && rm -rf "$OUT" && mkdir -p "$OUT" && cd .. && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -f lavfi -i testsrc=duration=8:size=320x240:rate=10 -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=8 -shortest "$OUT/test.mp4" && printf '1
00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000
[SHOUTING] I WILL DESTROY YOU

2
00:00:04,000 --> 00:00:06,000
calm line here
' > "$OUT/test.srt" && ./run.sh "$OUT/test.mp4" --subtitle "$OUT/test.srt" --emotion rage --fps 1 --no-whisper --out-dir "$OUT/run" --json > /dev/null
